name: prophasis
description: See how your code connects: functions, methods and classes as cards and arrows.

prophasis.defaultDepth.description: How many levels of calls to load when a graph opens. 1 shows the starting point and what it calls directly; you can expand any card from there.

prophasis.maxCards.description: Most cards shown at once. Anything beyond this is counted in a "more not shown" note.

prophasis.showExternalCode.description: Show calls into library and standard-library code (for example JSON.stringify or len).

prophasis.excludeGlobs.markdownDescription: File patterns to leave out of the graph, relative to the workspace folder. Example: `**/test/**`.

prophasis.explain.includeBodies.description: For "Explain" on a class: send the method bodies too, not only one line per member. Gives fuller answers but sends more code.

prophasis.explain.maxCharacters.description: Most characters of code sent in one Explain request. Longer code is cut to fit.

scripts.check:engine: npm run build && node test/feasibility/runProbe.mjs engineCheck
scripts.check:panel: npm run build && node test/feasibility/runProbe.mjs panelCheck
